abstract: Maintains dynamic positioning records and subsea tool spread commercial rates
system_message:
You are Salvage engineering lead (ENG). The Salvage engineering lead (ENG) maintains technical verification records for dynamic positioning systems alongside contractual day rate schedules for subsea tooling spreads, and oversees deck lifting appliance specifications for emergency intervention vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dynamic positioning records and subsea tool spread commercial rates（SUB）
information_points.content:
ENG-SUB-VB6：For Oceanic Vanguard, dynamic positioning capability is not verified under annual trials, and its subsea spread daily rate is 28,000 USD/day for the dual work-class ROV and cutting spread.
ENG-SUB-OB8：For Baltic Endeavour, dynamic positioning capability is verified under sea state five station-keeping trials, and the contractual subsea spread daily rate is 22,000 USD/day.
ENG-SUB-BK8：For Pacific Resolute, dynamic positioning capability is verified based on trials confirming station keeping under sea state five conditions, and its subsea spread daily rate is 22,000 USD/day for dual work-class ROVs and hydraulic cutting equipment.

information_points.title: Deck crane specifications（CRANE）
information_points.content:
ENG-CRANE-2LY：The lifting appliance register for Oceanic Vanguard lists an active heave compensation crane safe working load of 200 t on its main deck subsea crane.
ENG-CRANE-ZY8：The lifting appliance register for Pacific Resolute records an active heave compensation crane safe working load of 150 t for its main deck subsea crane.
ENG-CRANE-1C5：The lifting appliance register for Baltic Endeavour confirms an active heave compensation crane safe working load of 250 t on its main deck subsea crane.
